name: Summoned
source:
One sleepover gone wrong – you summoned the sins. Now try to survive them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

一场搞砸了的留宿聚会——你把罪孽们召唤出来了。现在，想办法从它们手里活下来吧。
